overall_acceptance_index.calculation: 100 * count(PASS) / 10; PARTIAL and UNVERIFIED each count zero
overall_acceptance_index.meaning: Fixed milestone acceptance index; not a measured fraction of engineering effort or a guarantee of whole-game playability

static_entry_templates.meaning: Static canRun validation, audio enabled, animation disabled; not execution/playability

automated_route_scene_inventory.meaning: Inventoried route scenes include variants; not a count of distinct puzzles or an exhaustive whole-game denominator

gates.title: Native ScummVM integration and reproducible local build
gates.pass_condition: The actual Windows x64 ScummVM engine detects the supported original copy, builds against the pinned core, and passes its current same-build execution checks.

gates.title: Ordinary launcher, input and navigation baseline
gates.pass_condition: Normal P1 startup uses the playable configuration and original input/navigation routes, with personal preferences and saves preserved and diagnostic mode disabled.
remaining: This gate covers the automated ordinary-start/input baseline; the integrated human UI check is A09.

gates.title: Exhaustive required original-behavior and branch inventory
gates.pass_condition: A versioned inventory identifies all required game routes and important alternative/failure/time-dependent branches from the original assets, maps each to execution evidence or an explicit accepted limitation, and leaves no required unknown branch.
remaining: The 35 inventoried route scenes include variants and do not establish an exhaustive whole-game route/branch denominator.
114/121 is static canRun with animation disabled, not executed original behavior; classify those seven rejects without automatically calling them bugs.
No new execution of the original Windows program is implied. Bounded unknowns remain until evidence or a documented scope decision resolves them.

gates.title: All currently inventoried puzzle route suites
gates.pass_condition: Every one of the 35 declared puzzle route scenes has passing automated native route checks on the same verified executable.
remaining: This gate closes the existing automated route inventory; A03 and A09 separately address its coverage limits and integrated play.

gates.title: Automated audiovisual pipeline and presentation
gates.pass_condition: The supported original video/WAV pipeline, Music/Effects behavior and full-frame presentation checks pass on the verified executable.
remaining: These are automated decoder/state/channel/pixel checks, not a claim of complete manual listening or whole-game audiovisual parity.

gates.title: Native reference-help content and interaction
gates.pass_condition: The native help reads and renders all781 original articles and31 original images with working article navigation, scrolling, search and modal return.
remaining: Original typography fidelity is deliberately a separate acceptance gate A08.

gates.title: Useful safe-boundary native saves for the complete puzzle-route inventory
gates.pass_condition: Exploration and all35 inventoried puzzle-route scenes support documented useful stable-progress save boundaries, with exact successor/fresh-process/metadata tests, malformed-load atomicity and backward compatibility.
remaining: 31supported scopes retain their explicit exclusions; arbitrary saves during every active voice, transition or pending command are not silently promised.
Current ambient restart convention does not preserve sample cursor; determine whether that convention is acceptable for the fixed release scope.

gates.title: Reference-help typography and layout fidelity
gates.pass_condition: Original paragraph/table measurements and required font/superscript presentation are reproduced and checked against original reference images.
remaining: Exact typography and original paragraph/table measurements remain outstanding.
13 original exponent runs are currently rendered using explicit ^(value) notation rather than faithful original superscript typography.

gates.title: Integrated manual audiovisual playthrough
gates.pass_condition: A human completes a normal new-game-to-ending playthrough on the supported original copy, checks mouse/UI/audio/video/help/save-resume at representative progress points and records reproducible outcomes; required alternate routes are checked or explicitly scoped.
remaining: User/manual confirmation is still required; automated component suites cannot mark this gate passed.
Observed issues may reopen the relevant gates.

gates.title: Regression integrity, compatibility and recoverable source publication
gates.pass_condition: The same executable completes the full suite, genuine previous-version slots remain compatible, exact source/build hashes are retained, and a clean source-only clone plus remote commit are verified and sealed.

frozen_rules: Keep exactly these ten gates and binary PASS scoring for future reports; do not split or merge gates to alter the percentage.
New acceptance requirements require an explicit versioned scheme change, not silent denominator changes.
A pending candidate does not invalidate the last verified baseline or earn a PASS before its required checks finish.
Do not overwrite existing official manifests containing whole_game_completion_percent=null with this different index.

Upstream merge acceptance, additional platforms/editions and distribution packaging are outside this Windows-original-copy target unless separately requested; official ScummVM submission readiness is not established by the private source publication.
